```{r functions}
source("catHeader.R")


investigate_raw_maps <- function(to_plot, request){
    request <- eval(request)
    request <- quo_name(enquo(request))
    
    raw_map(data = to_plot[[request]], 
            well = to_plot$well, 
            plate = 96) + labs(title = request)
}


investigate_b_maps <- function(to_plot, request){
    request <- eval(request)
    request <- quo_name(enquo(request))
    
    b_map(data = to_plot[[request]], 
          well = to_plot$well, 
          plate = 96) + labs(title = request)
}

```

```{r import}
    dplyr::rename(gene = cmpdname)


# the plates
plate_1 <- fread("PlateResults_plate1.txt", skip = 1) %>% 
    mutate(well = paste0(LETTERS[Row], sprintf("%02d", Column))) %>%
```

### Feature breakdown, raw values, plate 1 {.tabset .tabset-pills}

For a better picture of the data distribution, instead of just counts.

```{r rawbreakdown, results='asis', echo=FALSE}

pltting_list <- colnames(plate_1) #get list of variables to plot

pltting_list <-  pltting_list[! pltting_list %in% c("Row", "Column", "well", "gene")] #remove cluster and eid from list of names

plot_compile <- list() #start an empty list for storing the plots

for (i in seq_along(pltting_list)) { # loop across the list of variables to plot
    
    name <- paste0(pltting_list[i]) #make names for each plot
    plot_compile[[name]] <- investigate_raw_maps(to_plot = plate_1, #store in each unique name this following ggplot
                                                 request = pltting_list[i])
    
}

for (j in seq_along(plot_compile)) { # loop across list of plots
    
    tmp <- plot_compile[[j]] # store temporarily each ggplot
    
    catHeader(pltting_list[j], 4) #for tabs. comment out to see all at once
    
    print(tmp) #print each ggplot
    
}

```

## Jaccard Similarity Index

```{r jaccard_similarity, results='asis', echo=FALSE}

# Function to calculate Jaccard similarity index
jaccard_similarity <- function(x, y) {
    intersection <- length(intersect(x, y))
    union <- length(union(x, y))
    return(intersection / union)
}

# Calculate Jaccard similarity index for each pair of genes
genes <- unique(big_plate$gene)
jaccard_matrix <- matrix(0, nrow = length(genes), ncol = length(genes))
rownames(jaccard_matrix) <- genes
colnames(jaccard_matrix) <- genes

for (i in 1:length(genes)) {
    for (j in 1:length(genes)) {
        gene_i <- big_plate[big_plate$gene == genes[i], ]
        gene_j <- big_plate[big_plate$gene == genes[j], ]
        jaccard_matrix[i, j] <- jaccard_similarity(gene_i$well, gene_j$well)
    }
}

# Visualize the Jaccard similarity index using a heatmap
heatmaply::heatmaply(jaccard_matrix, 
                     main = "Jaccard Similarity Index",
                     xlab = "Genes", 
                     ylab = "Genes",
                     colors = viridis::viridis(200, option = "magma"))
```

### Edge effects

```{r effectsizes}

### merge all plates into one
big_plate <- rbindlist(list(plate_1, plate_2, plate_3), idcol = "plate") %>%
    as.data.frame() %>% 
    relocate(gene, .after = Column)

# make some additional ratios of interest

big_plate_additional_factors <- big_plate %>% 
    mutate(mt_per_cell = mitotracker_intensity_mean/nuclei_count,
           spots_per_cell = spot_count/nuclei_count, 
           spot_area_per_cell = spot_area/nuclei_count,
           spot_area_per_cell_area = spot_area/cell_area) %>% 
    filter(gene != "NTC2") %>% 
    mutate(gene = str_replace(gene, "^NTC[0-9]+$", "NTC"))

# calculate effect sizes for just nuclei count first


mean_NTC_p1 <- mean(big_plate_additional_factors$nuclei_count[big_plate_additional_factors$plate == 1 & str_detect(big_plate_additional_factors$gene, "NTC")])
mean_NTC_p2 <- mean(big_plate_additional_factors$nuclei_count[big_plate_additional_factors$plate == 2 & str_detect(big_plate_additional_factors$gene, "NTC")])
mean_NTC_p3 <- mean(big_plate_additional_factors$nuclei_count[big_plate_additional_factors$plate == 3 & str_detect(big_plate_additional_factors$gene, "NTC")])

stdev_p1 <- sd(big_plate_additional_factors$nuclei_count[big_plate_additional_factors$plate == 1 ])
stdev_p2 <- sd(big_plate_additional_factors$nuclei_count[big_plate_additional_factors$plate == 2 ])
stdev_p3 <- sd(big_plate_additional_factors$nuclei_count[big_plate_additional_factors$plate == 3 ])



big_plate_effect_sizes <- big_plate_additional_factors %>% 
    mutate(
        nuclei_count_z_score = case_when(
            plate == 1 ~ ((nuclei_count-mean_NTC_p1)/stdev_p1),
            plate == 2 ~ ((nuclei_count-mean_NTC_p2)/stdev_p2),
            plate == 3 ~ ((nuclei_count-mean_NTC_p3)/stdev_p3)),
        sigma_z_score =  sd(nuclei_count_z_score[str_detect(gene, "NTC")]),
        nuclei_count_effect_size = (nuclei_count_z_score/sigma_z_score)
    )

ggplot(big_plate_effect_sizes, mapping = aes(x = gene, y = nuclei_count_effect_size)) + 
    geom_boxplot()

ggplot(big_plate_effect_sizes, mapping = aes(x = gene, y = nuclei_count)) + 
    geom_boxplot()

### try to iterate the effect calculations

#variables_of_interest <- c("mt_per_cell", "spots_per_cell", "spot_area_per_cell", "spot_area_per_cell_area", "cell_area")[3]

stdev_p1 <- sd(big_plate_additional_factors[[variables_of_interest]][big_plate_additional_factors$plate == 1 ])
```

### Power calculations iteration function
```{r powercalcfunc}

no_NTCs <- 12

no_genes <- 9

pooled_sd <- sqrt( (((no_NTCs - 1)*(stdev_NTC_power^2)) + ((no_genes - 1)*(stdev_gene_power^2)))/(no_NTCs+no_genes-2))

no_control_wells <- 36

no_wells_compound <- 3

power_equiv <- (qnorm(0.8) + qnorm(0.95))*(pooled_sd * sqrt((1/no_control_wells) + (1/no_wells_compound)))/abs(mean_NTC_power - mean_gene_power)

variables_of_interest <- c(colnames(big_plate_additional_factors))[15]
gene_of_interest <- c(unique(big_plate_additional_factors$gene))[16] # c("IRS1", "PTEN")





### turn into function


PowerCalc <- function(variables_of_interest, gene_of_interest, no_control_wells, no_wells_compound, no_NTCs, no_genes){
    
    # NTC mean and stdev across all plates
    mean_NTC_power <- mean(big_plate_additional_factors[[variables_of_interest]][str_detect(big_plate_additional_factors$gene, "NTC")])
    stdev_NTC_power <- sd(big_plate_additional_factors[[variables_of_interest]][str_detect(big_plate_additional_factors$gene, "NTC")])
    

    # gene mean and stdev across all plates
    mean_gene_power <- mean(big_plate_additional_factors[[variables_of_interest]][str_detect(big_plate_additional_factors$gene, gene_of_interest)])
    stdev_gene_power <- sd(big_plate_additional_factors[[variables_of_interest]][str_detect(big_plate_additional_factors$gene, gene_of_interest)])
    
    #pooled sd
    pooled_sd <- sqrt( (((no_NTCs - 1)*(stdev_NTC_power^2)) + ((no_genes - 1)*(stdev_gene_power^2)))/(no_NTCs+no_genes-2))
    
    #final power calc
    power_equiv <- (qnorm(0.8) + qnorm(0.95))*(pooled_sd * sqrt((1/no_control_wells) + (1/no_wells_compound)))/abs(mean_NTC_power - mean_gene_power)
    
    # print answer
    print(power_equiv)

}

PowerCalc(variables_of_interest, gene_of_interest, no_control_wells, no_wells_compound, no_NTCs, no_genes)

PowerCalc(variables_of_interest, gene_of_interest, no_control_wells = 54, no_wells_compound = 6, no_NTCs, no_genes)


### turn into iterative function

variables_of_interest <- c(colnames(big_plate_additional_factors))[11]
genes_of_interest <- c(unique(big_plate_additional_factors$gene)) # c("IRS1", "PTEN")
results <- vector("list", length(genes_of_interest))

for (i in seq_along(genes_of_interest)) {
    
    temp_gene <- genes_of_interest[i]
    
    temp_power <- PowerCalc(variables_of_interest, temp_gene, no_control_wells = 84, no_wells_compound = 9, no_NTCs, no_genes)
    
    # Add to list
    
    results[[i]] <- list(gene = temp_gene, power = temp_power)

}

power_dataframe <- bind_rows(results)

ggplot(power_dataframe, mapping = aes(x = gene, y = power))+
    geom_point()+
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0.3, linetype = 2)+
    theme_minimal()+
    scale_x_discrete(guide = guide_axis(n.dodge = 2))+
    labs(title = paste0("Power calculations for ", variables_of_interest),
        subtitle = "For n = 9")+
    ylim(0,1)


```

### Effect sizes iteration
```{r iteration}

variables_of_interest <- setdiff(colnames(big_plate_additional_factors), c("plate","well","Row","Column","gene"))

for (temp_var in variables_of_interest) {
    
    
    mean_NTC_p1 <- mean(big_plate_additional_factors[[temp_var]][big_plate_additional_factors$plate == 1 & str_detect(big_plate_additional_factors$gene, "NTC")])
    mean_NTC_p2 <- mean(big_plate_additional_factors[[temp_var]][big_plate_additional_factors$plate == 2 & str_detect(big_plate_additional_factors$gene, "NTC")])
    mean_NTC_p3 <- mean(big_plate_additional_factors[[temp_var]][big_plate_additional_factors$plate == 3 & str_detect(big_plate_additional_factors$gene, "NTC")])
    
    
    stdev_p1 <- sd(big_plate_additional_factors[[temp_var]][big_plate_additional_factors$plate == 1 ])
    stdev_p2 <- sd(big_plate_additional_factors[[temp_var]][big_plate_additional_factors$plate == 2 ])
    stdev_p3 <- sd(big_plate_additional_factors[[temp_var]][big_plate_additional_factors$plate == 3 ])
    
    
    
    big_plate_effect_sizes <- big_plate_additional_factors %>% 
        mutate(
            nuclei_count_z_score = case_when(
                plate == 1 ~ ((.data[[temp_var]]-mean_NTC_p1)/stdev_p1),
                plate == 2 ~ ((.data[[temp_var]]-mean_NTC_p2)/stdev_p2),
                plate == 3 ~ ((.data[[temp_var]]-mean_NTC_p3)/stdev_p3)),
            sigma_z_score =  sd(nuclei_count_z_score[str_detect(gene, "NTC")]),
            nuclei_count_effect_size = (nuclei_count_z_score/sigma_z_score)
        )
    
    big_plate_effect_sizes <- big_plate_additional_factors %>%
        mutate(
            z_score_col = case_when(
                plate == 1 ~ (.data[[temp_var]] - mean_NTC_p1) / stdev_p1,
                plate == 2 ~ (.data[[temp_var]] - mean_NTC_p2) / stdev_p2,
                plate == 3 ~ (.data[[temp_var]] - mean_NTC_p3) / stdev_p3
            )
        )
    
    # Calculate sigma_z_score using the new z-score column
    sigma_z_score <- sd(big_plate_effect_sizes$z_score_col[str_detect(big_plate_effect_sizes$gene, "NTC")])
    
    # Add effect size column
    big_plate_effect_sizes <- big_plate_effect_sizes %>%
        mutate(
            effect_size = z_score_col/sigma_z_score
        )
    
    ggplot(big_plate_effect_sizes, mapping = aes(x = gene, y = effect_size)) + 
        geom_boxplot()+
        scale_x_discrete(guide = guide_axis(n.dodge = 2))+
        theme_minimal()+
        ggtitle(paste0(temp_var, " effect size")) -> p
    
    print(p)
    
    
    
}



```

```{r factorial}

# facet wrap

# List of columns to plot
y_columns <- setdiff(colnames(big_plate), c("plate","well","Row","Column","gene"))

# Pivot to long format
long_df <- big_plate %>%
    filter(gene %in% c("PTEN", "IRS1", "NTC1", "NTC3", "NTC4", "NTC5")) %>%
    pivot_longer(
        cols = all_of(y_columns),
        names_to = "measurement",
        values_to = "value"
    )

# Plot with facet_wrap for each measurement
ggplot(long_df, aes(x = gene, y = value)) +
    geom_boxplot() +
    scale_x_discrete(guide = guide_axis(n.dodge = 2)) +
    facet_wrap(~ measurement, scales = "free_y") +
    theme_minimal()


ggplot(long_df, aes(x = gene, y = value)) +
    geom_violin(trim = FALSE)+
    geom_point(width = 0.2)+
    scale_x_discrete(guide = guide_axis(n.dodge = 2)) +
    facet_wrap(~ measurement, scales = "free_y") +
    theme_minimal()
```
